source_limits.PMC7540900: Retrospective single-center Korean surgical adenocarcinoma cohort, 183 patients. Admit measurement-method context; staging/prognosis/treatment statements do not authorize patient advice.
source_limits.PMC9962587: Narrative review including human and animal evidence. Age/fat morphology context, not a validated contour rule or patient-specific reference interval.
